purpose: Dependency declaration, not a release, artifact-hash, signing, or notarization receipt.
policy: The native app never downloads executable code. Release assembly must supply the declared whisper-cli and its licenses for the published architectures. Only explicitly requested, size- and SHA256-verified speech model data is downloaded.

sharedSupport.name: RAPPDesktopSupport
sharedSupport.delivery: Compiled from the immutable Swift package source. SwiftPM and Xcode lockfiles are committed; no sibling checkout is needed.

required.name: whisper.cpp
required.usedFor: Local speech recognition through RAPPDesktopSupport.SpeechTranscriber; mono 16 kHz PCM WAV, English.
required.assembly: Built from the checksum-pinned source archive by parent-owned RAPP Tools, with static project libraries and only system dynamic libraries. No Homebrew, SDL, OpenMP, external dylibs or executable downloads are required on the consumer Mac.

platformEngine.name: Apple AVAudioEngine voice processing
platformEngine.delivery: Operating-system AVFoundation/AudioToolbox APIs, not a redistributed third-party executable.
platformEngine.claims: Explicit capture-time engine, not DeepFilterNet/RNNoise. No inherited denoising benchmark or far-end capture claim.

optionalNotBundled.name: DeepFilterNet3 deep-filter
optionalNotBundled.status: No signed two-architecture runtime is bundled with the native app. Select a trusted existing executable in Settings. The legacy installer may fetch only the listed release bytes after exact size/SHA-256 verification and leaves normal macOS quarantine/Gatekeeper handling intact. The adapter checks reported version 0.5.6 and records the selected executable's SHA256; that is provenance, not a claim of upstream signature verification.

optionalNotBundled.name: ffmpeg arnndn (RNNoise)
optionalNotBundled.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later for a qualifying LGPL configuration; GPL or other obligations depend on the supplied build.
optionalNotBundled.status: No FFmpeg executable is redistributed. The user-selected executable must advertise arnndn; its actual SHA256 is recorded. A redistributable build requires separately pinned source, build configuration, libraries and license review before bundling.

optionalNotBundled.name: GregorR RNNoise models
optionalNotBundled.upstreamRightsStatement: The upstream README asserts that work other than tools/ and README.md is non-creative and not subject to copyright; it does not provide a conventional model SPDX license.
optionalNotBundled.status: Models are not bundled or downloaded by the native app. A user can select an existing .rnnn file; the actual model SHA256 is recorded. The legacy installer fetches only the commit-pinned files listed here after exact size/SHA-256 verification.

notesProvider: No notes provider executable, account, or credentials are bundled. User-selected hooks require separately stored, executable- and destination-bound consent. The example claude hook is cloud-capable and disabled by default.
